verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting, and gateway platform, so an official SDK is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions any official client SDK or library. The mcp-proxy tunneling tool, the connector JSON schema, and copy-paste config blocks are adjacent tooling, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
